explanation: Sweep changes at each inclusive left endpoint and one position after each inclusive right endpoint. Between changes, the tallest active building fixes the height. Emit zero-height gaps and merge adjacent spans of equal height. A multiset tracks repeated heights.
timeComplexity: O(n log n) At most 2n events and n active insertions/removals each cost O(log(n+1)).
spaceComplexity: O(n) Events, active heights and output spans are each O(n).
attribution: Original C# implementation and explanation authored for EPI Practice from the displayed problem contract.
correctness: Active heights change only at a building’s inclusive left endpoint or one position after its inclusive right endpoint. The maximum active height is constant between changes. Emitting those intervals and coalescing equal adjacent heights therefore yields exactly the maximal skyline spans.
walkthrough: Buildings [1,1,4] and [3,3,2] occupy positions 1 and 3. Position 2 is uncovered, so output [1,1,4], [2,2,0] and [3,3,2].
edgeCases: Uncovered internal gaps are emitted at height zero.
Repeated equal heights require multiplicity counts, not just a set.
